message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Go

on:
  push:
    branches: [ master ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ master ]
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 12 * * 0'

jobs:

  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        go: ['1.26.x', '1.27.x']
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v7

    - name: Set up Go
      uses: actions/setup-go@v7
      with:
        go-version: ${{ matrix.go }}

    - name: Cache Go modules
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: ~/go/pkg/mod
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-go-${{ hashFiles('go.mod', 'go.sum') }}

    - name: Install errcheck
      run: go install github.com/kisielk/errcheck@v1.30.0

    - name: errcheck
      run: errcheck -verbose ./...

    - name: gofmt check
      run: diff <(gofmt -d .) <(echo -n "")

    - name: Test
      run: go test -race -v ./...

    - name: Coveralls
      if: ${{ startsWith(matrix.go, '1.27') && github.event_name == 'push' }}
      env:
          COVERALLS_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      run: |
        go install github.com/mattn/goveralls@latest && \
        go test -covermode=count -coverprofile=profile.cov ./... && \
        goveralls -coverprofile=profile.cov -service=github",
  "rationale": "The workflow is a Go CI that repeatedly fetches module dependencies across matrix Go versions and scheduled runs, and the repository contains go.mod/go.sum. Evidence P-LIT-GHA-CACHE (experiment batch-interactive-three--f6d2974a5cef7cc9) measured adding actions/cache@v4 for ~/go/pkg/mod keyed on runner OS plus hashFiles('go.mod', 'go.sum'), preserving all test steps, with 3/3 successes and 6.06% elapsed savings. Preconditions are met: repeated dependency fetching is measurable and cache inputs include the lockfile. No contraindications apply: there is no existing equivalent cache and no mutable/untrusted cached content. The change is minimal, adds no secrets, permissions, network access, or deployment steps, and preserves all build/test coverage including errcheck, gofmt, race tests, and coveralls.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-interactive-three--f6d2974a5cef7cc9", "pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}
